title: Feature capability layout
description: Normative layout for OpenSpec feature capabilities. Every feature spec.md declares a single title, a Purpose narrative, and a Requirements section carrying at least one normative requirement.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.description: One or more paragraphs describing why the capability exists.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.description: Holds one or more `### Requirement:` blocks stating normative SHALL/MUST behavior.
